use_cases: Displaying image galleries with immersive scroll-driven horizontal navigation
Creating storytelling experiences with horizontally scrolling content sections
Showcasing portfolio work or featured projects with parallax-like image cards
Building interactive product showcases with hover zoom effects on images
Designing visual-heavy landing pages with scroll-triggered animations
ai_summary: A scroll-driven horizontal carousel component that translates vertical scroll momentum into smooth horizontal card movement using framer-motion. Features image cards with backdrop-blur text overlays and hover zoom effects. The sticky container creates an immersive full-screen scrolling experience ideal for visual storytelling and portfolio showcases.
